svg.title: JEXI OS architecture
svg.desc: A layered architecture: Surfaces, Executive Kernel, Orchestration and Work Graph, Agent Workforce, Brain and Mind, Tools and MCP, Runtimes. Commands flow down, evidence flows up; cross-cutting concerns span every layer.
svg.text: agentic operating system · Node.js 22 · local-first · v1.2.0
every tool call returns a receipt
clients that submit intent and render the event stream
one control layer: intent, policy, budgets, scheduling, recovery
missions become graphs; nodes are executed, claimed, verified
400 agents across 18 divisions, resolved through one registry
reasoning, context, memory, and the provider fabric
permission-gated capabilities that reach the world and return receipts
vision-grounded control of browser, desktop, and sandbox

Flow: a surface submits intent → the kernel gates and schedules it → orchestration builds a work graph → agents reason through the brain and act through gated tools → runtimes touch the world → receipts and evidence return to the kernel and the transcript.
Counts are read from this repository: 400 agents · 18 divisions · 39 tools · 12 domains · 1,164 skills · 56 MCP servers · 30 hook events · 5 memory verbs · 13 dream-cycle phases.
